newsitem.title: USA: IMM currency futures stick mostly higher.
newsitem.headline: IMM currency futures stick mostly higher.

text.p: April 18 - IMM currency futures stuck at mostly higher levels in quiet pit trading. Currencies showed muted reaction when prelim April U of Mich consumer sentiment index reported at 101.00 versus 99.8 expected. Can dollar stable but some see more downside nearterm. Talk of possible Canadian tightening resurfaces. June Can dollar nearterm support seen at $0.7148. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750/)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
